title: (0Day) PublicCMS getXml Server-Side Request Forgery Information Disclosure Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of PublicCMS. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the getXml method. The issue results from the lack of authorization prior to allowing access to functionality. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of the application.
